name: Medusa speedup degradation beyond batch size 32
methodology: Simulated on A100 80GB PCIe, sequence length 1024. Speedup measured across batch sizes 1-64.
notes: Medusa paper Appendix G.3: 'when the batch size exceeds 32, the speedup decreases and may even have a negative effect.' This occurs because linear layers shift from memory-bandwidth-bound to compute-bound. At batch 1, Medusa achieves >2.2x speedup; at batch 32+, the speedup degrades and can become negative (slower than baseline). This is the key measured evidence for the batch dilution problem.
